test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The work will be finished by the mason within a short time.

options.text: The mason will be finishing the work within a short time.
The mason would have finish the work within a short time.
The mason would finish the work within a short time.
The mason will finish the work within a short time.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The mason will finish the work within a short time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a passive voice sentence, **the subject receives the action**.
 
• **Passive Voice Structure**: Object + Be verb + V3 + Subject__
